chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from 'Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from 'Amr ibn 'Anbasah al-Sulami, who said:

I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saying: 'Any man who has three children who die before reaching puberty, or a woman who has three children who die, these children will act as a shield (hujjab) that covers him from the Fire.'
ai.seo_question: How many children must die before puberty to shield parents from Hellfire?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the intercessory power of young children who die before reaching the age of *hinth* (puberty/maturity), serving as a spiritual shield (*hujjab*) for their parents against the Hellfire. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the merit of offspring in the afterlife, linking parental devotion to divine mercy through the innocent status of their pre-pubescent children.
